evals.name: ava-aiuc-readiness
evals.prompt: Sales wants AIUC-1 certification for our support agent Ava by Q2 2027. The agent description and our current controls (from SOC 2 and team notes) are attached. Where are we, and what do we need to do?
evals.expected_output: Readiness mode for the company's own agent. Capability tags: Universal, External-facing, Text-generation, Automation (refunds, order lookup). SoA generated with make_checklist.py; Code-generation-only requirements (A008, B010) excluded by capability with justification; image/voice-only items excluded similarly. SOC 2 controls mapped to CCOs (MFA CCO-15, access review, change management CCO-17, logging CCO-18 → E015, encryption CCO-16 → B008), with SOC 2 evidence valid for its period only. Gaps: third-party testing A009, B001, C010, D004, E018 Not covered; AI failure plans E001-E003 Not covered (IR plan general); vendor and model due diligence E006 Partly (onboarding 2025 only); AI disclosure E016 Partly or Not (greeting doesn't say it's AI); guardrails C003-C005 Partly (system prompt untested); B006 and D003 Partly (refund cap enforced in code, but no broader action limits tested); hallucination D001 Not covered. Quarterly testing scheduled as controls with next_test dates. States readiness only, not certification. Control entries, index, readiness report, and schedule.md built. Reply about 150 words.
